title: Rh3+ stabilized in KRh@MFI catalyses regioselective hydroformylation
title_zh: Rh3+ 在 KRh@MFI 中稳定 并催化区域选择性氢甲酰化
abstract: Hydroformylation has been a cornerstone of industrial organometallic catalysis, with regioselectivity being a critical aspect in this process1,2. Present industrial systems use homogeneous Rh-based catalysts with expensive and toxic phosphine-containing ligands, underscoring the need to develop alternative heterogeneous catalysts that could compete with the actual homogeneous ones3. In this direction, atomically dispersed Rh catalysts have been proposed as promising candidates for hydroformylation4,5. However, achieving high regioselectivity at high conversion is still a big challenge. Here subnanometre Rh2O3 clusters are confined inside the channels of the MFI zeolite, which under reaction conditions disrupt into isolated Rh3+ and Rh+ species. Density functional theory (DFT) investigations combined with spectroscopic and catalytic studies demonstrate that Rh3+-mediated hydroformylation is energetically plausibly similar to Rh+, with Rh3+ being intrinsically more selective for hydroformylation and less selective for double-bond isomerization than Rh+. In the coexistence of both Rh3+ and Rh+ species, we demonstrate the possibility to selectively inhibit Rh+ sites through the addition of N-containing molecules such as N-methylpyrrolidine (MP) or 1-methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP), which preferentially coordinate to Rh+ inside MFI zeolite channel, thereby suppressing its isomerization function while leaving Rh3+ sites catalytically accessible. This strategy results in a notable enhancement of regioselectivity, with a state-of-the-art reported highest linear to branched aldehydes (l/b) ratio of 817 with 96% undecanal selectivity at 99.8% 1-decene conversion, using NMP as additive. DFT investigations combined with spectroscopic and catalytic studies of disrupted subnanometric Rh2O3 clusters show that Rh+ centres in a zeolite-based catalyst are blocked with N-containing molecules, whereas Rh3+ sites are stabilized, allowing hydroformylation reactions with enhanced regioselectivity and efficiency.
abstract_zh: 氢甲酰化是工业有机金属催化的基石，其中区域选择性是该过程的关键方面1,2。目前的工业体系使用带有昂贵且有毒的膦配体的均相氢化铑催化剂，这凸显了开发可与实际均相催化剂竞争的异相催化剂的必要性3。在这一方向上，已提出原子分散的铑催化剂作为氢甲酰化的有前景的候选者4,5。然而，在高转化率下实现高区域选择性仍然是一个巨大的挑战。在此，亚纳米级的 Rh2O3 簇被限制在 MFI 沸石的通道中，在反应条件下会分解为孤立的 Rh3+ 和 Rh+ 物种。通过密度泛函理论（DFT）研究以及光谱和催化研究表明，Rh3+ 媒介的氢甲酰化在能量上与 Rh+ 相似，Rh3+ 天生对氢甲酰化的选择性更高，对双键异构化的选择性低于 Rh+。在同时存在 Rh3+ 和 Rh+ 物种的情况下，我们展示了通过添加 N-含有分子（如 N-甲基吡咯烷胺（MP）或 1-甲基-2-吡咯烷酮（NMP））选择性抑制 Rh+ 位的可能性，这些分子优先在 MFI 沸石通道中与 Rh+ 协同，从而抑制其异构化功能，同时保持 Rh3+ 位点的催化活性。这种策略显著提高了区域选择性，报道的最高线性/分支醛（l/b）比达到 817，在 1-庚烯 99.8% 转化率下实现了 96% 正己醛选择性，添加剂使用 NMP。通过光谱和催化研究对被破坏的亚纳米级 Rh2O3 簇的 DFT 研究结合表明，在沸石基催化剂中，Rh+ 中心与 N-含有分子结合，而 Rh3+ 位点被稳定，从而实现了区域选择性和效率提升的氢甲酰化反应。
